messages.author: 3ef7a01c7d912ca2
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How can I destroy or delete an archived application
parts:
I am surprised that even now the application is going beta, there is no provision to completely delete an application. On another thread, it was suggested to me the only possibility is to overwrite the code with a dummy application.

This is a security concern for all serious users. I am a long-time follower of RStudio and love the work you do, but this is an annoying omission.

We will recommend against using shinyapps in any application with security issues.

Dieter Menne

Menne Biomed Consulting

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How can I destroy or delete an archived application
parts:
Thanks for the feedback Dieter,
it is definitely on our list of work to do, and we recognize its importance but we felt that getting more feedback on the viability of the business behind shinyapps.io was a higher priority.  The complete implementation of delete is a little more involved and we wanted to tackle it holistically.  To be clear on what the "Security issue" risk is here is more about RStudio conceivably going to look at an application and its data.   There is no way to serve an archived app, and everything related to the application is segmented by account with strict permissioning.  It isn't clear just how prevalent the need for delete is versus some of the other missing capabilities in the platform which are more widely applicable to the larger audience.  

Best,
-Tareef
